# Xodus Nexus 0.3.7

- Add local backend diagnostic logs with an in-app viewer and Copy log button for troubleshooting sign-in, library and installation problems. Logs are not uploaded automatically.
- Keep valid My Library entries visible when some license records cannot be verified, with a warning when results are incomplete.
- Improve button spacing in Advanced / Diagnostics and make diagnostic logs easier to read.

Update the Nexus backend to **0.2.7** in Settings for the accompanying library-loading improvements.
